title: HorizonCraft
description: Simple in-development Minecraft plugin adding claim protection and player trading system via /claim /troc and /jobs commandes!
body: In development Minecraft plugin adding claim and trade system. Use /troc to open GUI, /troc sell to sell items, /claim to protect land with emerald cost. More features coming soon. (in development not finish!) Download it to support the project and help future updates! 🚀
